message.content:
The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 S and US‑101 S routes. Under normal conditions—no major traffic jams, construction, or weather delays—a typical car would cover that distance in about **6 to 7 hours**.  

If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates (e.g., Google Maps, Waze, or the California Department of Transportation) before you leave, as rush hour, accidents, or road work can add an hour or more to the journey.
